description.zh: 阅读和分析作品样本（文档、图片、音频的内容与元数据），梳理创作时间线和权属线索、识别 AI 生成痕迹、初筛疑似抄袭；指导作品登记和软件著作权登记并自动生成源程序材料；生成作品指纹存证清单；解读著作权法律法规和地方登记资助政策，对比新旧条文；提供权属认定、授权许可和侵权应对建议。意见仅供参考，不构成法律意见。
description.en: Reads and analyses work samples (content and metadata of documents, images and audio) to trace creation timelines and ownership clues, spot AI-generation traces and screen for copying; guides work and software copyright registration and generates source-code deposit documents; builds fingerprint evidence manifests; interprets copyright law and local subsidy policies with version diffs; advises on ownership, licensing and enforcement. For reference only, not legal advice.

welcome_message.zh: 把作品样本发给我，或说说你要登记、存证还是维权
welcome_message.en: Send me your work samples, or tell me whether you need registration, evidence or enforcement

prompt.zh: 帮我分析这些作品样本，看看创作时间、作者和有没有 AI 生成痕迹：___
prompt.en: Inspect these work samples for creation time, author and AI traces: ___

prompt.zh: 我的作品 ___ 可能被盗用了，帮我和这些疑似侵权的作品比对：___
prompt.en: My work ___ may have been copied; compare it with these: ___

prompt.zh: 我想给 ___（作品类别）办理著作权登记，需要准备什么？帮我写作品创作说明。
prompt.en: I want to register ___ (type); what do I need? Draft the creation statement.

prompt.zh: 帮我准备软件著作权登记材料：软件名称 ___，版本 ___，代码在 ___。
prompt.en: Prepare software copyright filing: name ___, version ___, code in ___.

prompt.zh: 给 ___ 目录下的作品生成存证清单，权利人是 ___。
prompt.en: Build an evidence manifest for works in ___, owner ___.

prompt.zh: 帮我解读 ___（政策名称或链接），看看我能不能申请版权登记资助。
prompt.en: Interpret ___ (policy) and check whether I qualify for registration subsidies.

zh: 每月 1 日「10:00」检查本月新完成的作品，生成存证清单
每周一「9:00」检索我的代表作品是否在网上被盗用
每年 3 月 1 日「10:00」检索本地版权登记资助政策的申报通知
每季度第一天「10:00」核验存证清单，确认作品文件未被改动
每月 15 日「10:00」汇总待办理登记的作品和材料准备进度
每次新版本软件发布后「立即」准备软著登记材料
en: On the 1st of each month at 10:00, build evidence manifests for newly finished works
Every Monday at 9:00, search for unauthorised use of my key works
Every March 1 at 10:00, look for local copyright registration subsidy notices
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, verify evidence manifests
On the 15th of each month at 10:00, summarise works pending registration
After each software release, prepare software copyright filing materials
